assessment: This research work uncovered the role of a long noncoding RNA VPS9D1-AS1(VPS) in mediating immune evasion of colorectal cancer cells, which is achieved via amplifying intra-tumoral TGF-β/ISG signaling to facilitate escape from cytotoxic T cells killing. Overall, the experiments were well-designed and the data were properly analyzed. The findings are of potential significance to gaining insight into treating colorectal cancer cells by enhancing the efficacy of immunotherapy
